title: CIDAR: Culturally Relevant Instruction Dataset For Arabic

bias_targets.methodology: Using Named Entity Recognition (NER) to extract and compare the frequency of Arab versus Western names and locations, analyzing dataset topic coverage (e.g., local traditions vs. Western concepts), and qualitatively evaluating the outputs of fine-tuned models on culturally nuanced instructions.

Analyzing the modification rates and lengths of instructions and outputs before and after human review to measure the correction of machine translation errors, 'translationese', and alignment with native Arabic grammatical structures.
